cohort: 742 women undergoing caesarean delivery at a single institution, with 343 receiving low-pressured 0.05% chlorhexidine gluconate irrigation and 399 serving as a standard-of-care control group.
finding: While not statistically significant, intraoperative irrigation with 0.05% chlorhexidine gluconate during caesarean delivery resulted in a lower infection rate compared to the control group.
